name: Optimize Microsoft Edge
description: Disables telemetry, EdgeUpdate services and useless tasks to reduce background resource usage
commands:
# Run in 64-bit PowerShell as Administrator
 
 # helper to write HKLM policy values
 function Set-PolValue($Path,$Name,$Type,[object]$Value){
  if(!(Test-Path $Path)){ New-Item $Path -Force  }
  New-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $Name -PropertyType $Type -Value $Value -Force 
 }
 
 # ---- Edge privacy/policy ----
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'DiagnosticData' DWord 0
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'MetricsReportingEnabled' DWord 0
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'SendSiteInfoToImproveServices' DWord 0
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'UserFeedbackAllowed' DWord 0
 
 # ---- Block Edge migration/update installs ----
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate' 'DoNotUpdateToEdgeWithChromium' DWord 1
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate' 'InstallDefault' DWord 0
 $edgeGuids = @(
  '{56EB18F8-B008-4CBD-B6D2-8C97FE7E9062}',
  '{2CD8A007-E189-409D-A2C8-9AF4EF3C72AA}',
  '{65C35B14-6C1D-4122-AC46-7148CC9D6497}',
  '{0D50BFEC-CD6A-4F9A-964C-C7416E3ACB10}',
  '{F3017226-FE2A-4295-8BDF-00C3A9A7E4C5}',
  '{F3C4FE00-EFD5-403B-9569-398A20F1BA4A}'
 )
 foreach($g in $edgeGuids){
  Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate' ("Install$g") DWord 0
 }
 
 # ---- Disable Edge Update services ----
 foreach($svc in 'edgeupdate','edgeupdatem'){
  $s = Get-Service $svc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if($s){
  if($s.Status -eq 'Running'){ Stop-Service $svc -Force }
  Set-Service $svc -StartupType Disabled
  }
 }
 
 # ---- Disable scheduled tasks (handles GUID suffix) ----
 Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like 'MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachineCore{*}' -or $_.TaskName -like 'MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachineUA{*}' } |
  Disable-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue 
 
 # ---- Kill running updater and block via IFEO + DisallowRun ----
 Get-Process MicrosoftEdgeUpdate -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe' 'Debugger' String "$env:WINDIR\System32\taskkill.exe"
 
 $dr = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer\DisallowRun'
 if(!(Test-Path $dr)){ New-Item $dr -Force  }
 Set-ItemProperty $dr -Name '1' -Value 'MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe' -Type String -Force
 
 # ---- Freeze EdgeUpdate (updates) ----
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate' 'UpdateDefault' DWord 0
 foreach($g in $edgeGuids){
  Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate' ("Update$g") DWord 0
 }
 
 # ---- Optional Edge UI policies ----
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'HubsSidebarEnabled' DWord 0
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'StandaloneHubsSidebarEnabled' DWord 0
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'DiscoverPageContextEnabled' DWord 0
 Set-PolValue 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' 'FavoritesContextMenuEnabled' DWord 0
